import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# --- Data Preparation ---
# Filter out 'Unbekannt' (unknown) and 'Mischling' (mixed breed) from Rasse1Text
# These categories are not specific breeds and can skew breed popularity insights.
df_filtered = df[~df['Rasse1Text'].isin(['Unbekannt', 'Mischling'])].copy()
df_filtered.dropna(subset=['Rasse1Text'], inplace=True) # Remove rows where Rasse1Text is NaN

# Aggregate the number of registered dogs (AnzHunde) by year and primary breed
# 'AnzHunde' represents the number of dogs in a registration, so summing it is appropriate.
breed_yearly_counts = df_filtered.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'Rasse1Text'])['AnzHunde'].sum().reset_index()

# Calculate the total count for each breed across all years to identify the most popular ones
total_breed_counts = breed_yearly_counts.groupby('Rasse1Text')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Select the top N breeds for visualization (e.g., top 10)
top_n = 10
top_breeds = total_breed_counts.head(top_n).index.tolist()

# Filter the aggregated data to include only these top breeds
top_breeds_yearly_data = breed_yearly_counts[breed_yearly_counts['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Ensure all selected top breeds are present for all years in the dataset,
# filling missing years with 0 registrations to create continuous lines in the plot.
years = sorted(df_filtered['StichtagDatJahr'].unique())
full_data_for_plot = pd.DataFrame()
for breed in top_breeds:
    breed_data = top_breeds_yearly_data[top_breeds_yearly_data['Rasse1Text'] == breed].copy()
    
    # Create a DataFrame with all relevant years for the current breed
    all_years_for_breed = pd.DataFrame({'StichtagDatJahr': years, 'Rasse1Text': breed})
    
    # Merge with the actual breed data, filling missing years with 0 registrations
    breed_data_full_years = pd.merge(all_years_for_breed, breed_data, on=['StichtagDatJahr', 'Rasse1Text'], how='left')
    breed_data_full_years['AnzHunde'].fillna(0, inplace=True)
    
    full_data_for_plot = pd.concat([full_data_for_plot, breed_data_full_years])

# --- Visualization ---
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
sns.lineplot(
    data=full_data_for_plot,
    x='StichtagDatJahr',
    y='AnzHunde',
    hue='Rasse1Text',
    marker='o', # Add markers for data points
    linewidth=2
)

# Customize the plot
plt.title(f'Trends of Top {top_n} Dog Breeds in Zurich ({min(years)}-{max(years)})', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(years) # Ensure all unique years are shown as x-axis ticks
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
plt.legend(title='Dog Breed', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
